---
title: "Cleaning and Processing"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
source("01_funct_DataCleaning.R")
```


```{r}
clinical_data <- read.csv("clinical_data.csv")

summary(clinical_data)
```

```{r}
relevant_cols <- c("ER_STATUS", "GRADE", "TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS", "TUMOR_SIZE", "AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS", "LYMPH_NODES_EXAMINED_POSITIVE", "OS_STATUS", "RFS_STATUS")
relevant_clinical_data <- clinical_data[, relevant_cols]

missing <- is.na(relevant_clinical_data)
View(missing)
byrow_missing <- apply(missing, MARGIN = 1, sum)

cleaned_clinical_data <- relevant_clinical_data[byrow_missing == 0, ]
```


```{r}
# Overall survival status and Recurrence-free survival should be represented as true or false
cleaned_clinical_data$OS_BOOL <- NA
cleaned_clinical_data$OS_BOOL[cleaned_clinical_data$OS_STATUS == "1:DECEASED"] <- 1
cleaned_clinical_data$OS_BOOL[cleaned_clinical_data$OS_STATUS == "0:LIVING"]   <- 0

cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_BOOL <- NA
cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_BOOL[cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_STATUS == "1:Recurred"]     <- 1
cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_BOOL[cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_STATUS == "0:Not Recurred"] <- 0

cleaned_clinical_data$OS_STATUS  <- NULL
cleaned_clinical_data$RFS_STATUS <- NULL
```


```{r}
# Grade and ER Status should be turned to factors
cleaned_clinical_data$GRADE  <- turn_to_factor(cleaned_clinical_data, 2)
cleaned_clinical_data$ER_STATUS <- turn_to_factor(cleaned_clinical_data, 1)

summary(cleaned_clinical_data)
```
```{r}
save(cleaned_clinical_data, file = "12_DataSaving.RData")
```
